title: Karnai language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Karnai ('Barim') is an Austronesian language spoken by about 915 individuals in small villages near Wasu, Morobe Province, on Umboi Island, and near Saidor in Madang Province, Papua New Guinea.
